questions.question: Researchers _____ significant progress in renewable energy over the past decade.
questions.explanation_cn: over the past decade 表示从过去持续到现在，应使用现在完成时。
questions.explanation_en: 'Over the past decade' refers to a period continuing to the present, so use the present perfect.

questions.question: At the moment, many universities _____ online learning platforms.
questions.explanation_cn: At the moment 表示此刻正在发生，应使用现在进行时。
questions.explanation_en: 'At the moment' indicates an action happening now, so use the present continuous.

questions.question: By the time the lecture started, most students _____ their seats.
questions.explanation_cn: 一个过去动作发生在另一个过去动作之前，应使用过去完成时。
questions.explanation_en: Use the past perfect for an action completed before another past action.

questions.question: If the weather is fine tomorrow, we _____ the field survey.
questions.explanation_cn: 第一类条件句：If + 一般现在时，主句使用 will + 动词原形。
questions.explanation_en: In the first conditional, use the present simple after 'if' and 'will' in the main clause.

questions.question: Scientists _____ the effects of climate change for many years before the policy was introduced.
questions.explanation_cn: 强调过去某动作持续了一段时间并发生在另一个过去动作之前，应使用过去完成进行时。
questions.explanation_en: Use the past perfect continuous to emphasize duration before another past event.

questions.question: This time next week, I _____ my final IELTS preparation course.
questions.explanation_cn: This time next week 表示未来某一时刻正在进行，应使用将来进行时。
questions.explanation_en: 'This time next week' refers to an action in progress at a future time, requiring the future continuous.

questions.question: I _____ this research article already, so I don't need to read it again.
questions.explanation_cn: already 常与现在完成时连用，表示已经完成。
questions.explanation_en: 'Already' is commonly used with the present perfect to describe completed actions.

questions.question: While the professor _____ the lecture, several students were taking notes.
questions.explanation_cn: while 引导持续动作，通常使用过去进行时。
questions.explanation_en: 'While' often introduces a continuous action in the past, requiring the past continuous.

questions.question: By 2035, renewable energy _____ the primary source of electricity in many countries.
questions.explanation_cn: By + 将来时间，通常使用将来完成时。
questions.explanation_en: Use the future perfect after 'By' when referring to a completed future action.

questions.question: The graph shows that the unemployment rate _____ steadily since 2020.
questions.explanation_cn: since 2020 表示从过去持续到现在，因此使用现在完成时。这也是 IELTS Writing Task 1 的高频表达。
questions.explanation_en: 'Since 2020' requires the present perfect because the action continues to the present.

questions.question: Which of the following sentences are grammatically correct?

options.text: I have lived in Australia since 2022.
When I arrived, the meeting had already started.
She has finished the report yesterday.
By next month, they will have completed the project.

questions.explanation_cn: A：since + 时间点，用现在完成时。B：过去完成时表示'过去的过去'。C：错误，yesterday 是明确过去时间，应使用一般过去时（finished）。D：By next month 使用将来完成时，是 IELTS/PTE 高频考点。
questions.explanation_en: A correctly uses the present perfect with 'since'. B correctly uses the past perfect for an earlier past action. C is incorrect because 'yesterday' requires the simple past. D correctly uses the future perfect with 'By next month'.
